x: Compliance with Indian Fire Safety Standards
R&D and Innovation in Fire Safety Products

x.Fire Suppression System Product Breadth: Range of fire suppression products offered, including sprinklers, extinguishers, hydrants, and gaseous systems. Strength shown by comprehensive portfolio covering diverse applications like commercial, industrial, and residential.
x.Compliance with Indian Fire Safety Stand: Degree to which products meet Indian standards such as IS 2190, IS 3844, and NBC 2016. Evidence includes BIS certifications, test reports, and approvals from Indian fire authorities.
x.Advanced Detection & Suppression Technol: Use of modern technologies like addressable detection, clean agents, and IoT-enabled monitoring. Strength indicated by features like early warning, automatic activation, and integration with building management systems.
x.Manufacturing & Supply Chain Capability: Local manufacturing capacity, quality control, and supply chain efficiency in India. Evidence includes number of plants, production volume, lead times, and localization of components.
x.R&D and Innovation in Fire Safety Produc: Investment in research and development for new products and improvements. Strength shown by patents, new product launches, and collaboration with research institutions.

y.Installed Base & Key Customer Contracts: Number of installations and major clients in India, such as government projects, industrial plants, and commercial buildings. Evidence includes named contracts, project references, and repeat customers.
y.Revenue & Growth in Indian Market: Sales revenue and growth rate from Indian operations. Strength indicated by consistent revenue growth, market share expansion, and financial reports.
y.Distribution & Channel Network in India: Extent of dealer, distributor, and partner network across Indian states. Evidence includes number of channel partners, geographic coverage, and presence in key cities.
y.After-Sales Service & Maintenance Covera: Availability and quality of service and maintenance across India. Strength shown by number of service centers, response times, and annual maintenance contract offerings.
y.Financial Strength & Investment Capacity: Financial health, profitability, and ability to invest in expansion. Evidence includes balance sheet strength, credit rating, and funding for new projects.
